Book correction: The last term of S(t) = 3t^2 - 2t \ldots is overprinted in the book: two characters lie on top of each other, and it can be read as +5 or as -6. We cannot tell from the print alone. The answer key (PDF 307) gives this question's answer as entry 7, "45", and S(4) = 45 only when the constant is +5 (with -6 it would be 34). So we solved with +5, the reading the key implies.
